requirements.note: Both ja/en guides now require `register(container)` as default export and explicitly reject direct class default export.
Both guides add explicit `container.get(...)` usage for base classes/utilities and forbid old internal import paths.
Both guides describe and exemplify parent Source/Entry inheritance via `container.getPreset("<parent>").dataSources`.
Legacy `sdd-forge/api`/`sdd-forge/presets/*` import patterns and old entry-style guidance were removed/replaced with current DI contract.

requirements.note: Both guides add an external preset compatibility section that allows only `peerDependencies` and forbids independent Container API version fields.
Both guides include definition, placement/layout, implementation contract, test layout, and validation commands end-to-end.
